'''Ebenga''' was a [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked for the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], Ebenga was sent to track the suspected Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Alma (Ord Mantell)|Alma]] near [[Fort Garnik]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. When Alma asked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] individual to retrieve a family heirloom necklace from her home in [[Talloran village]], Ebenga was able to intercept the individual and revealed that the spy's heirloom was actually a recording device. After retrieving the device, the individual gave it to Ebenga, and the Arcona was able to pass it to the SIS for decryption and analysis.<ref name="Scavenger Hunt" /> Ebenga later mentioned the individual in his report to [[Harson Nild]], the [[Director of Core World Operations|Director]] of the [[Core Worlds Operations Group]].<ref name="Message">{{TORcite|type=message|"Lost" Communications Device|Harson Nild}}</ref>
